== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-abe-christensen-ls-let-the-wookie-win-v-chewies-hut/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Christensen LS LTWW(v).txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114031042/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-abe-christensen-ls-let-the-wookie-win-v-chewies-hut.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>929d63c6ba1fce4f0a841784534cea62ab219e19618d1d69861690f778e3cb07</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 22 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut (Errata 2)]] (<nowiki>226_17</nowiki>, locationLightSideGameText): engine reference <nowiki>Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may [upload] a Wookiee. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force Drains here.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may take a Wookiee into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force drains here.</nowiki>.
